name: rducks_enable
description: Load the Rducks DuckDB extension into a connection. R-backed DuckDB scalar UDF, aggregate, and table registration require explicit single-thread setup via threads = 'single'.

name: rducks_register_scalar_udf
signature: rducks_register_scalar_udf(con, name, fun, args, returns, mode, null_handling, exception_handling, side_effects)
description: Register an R function as a DuckDB scalar UDF. In DuckDB terms the function returns one SQL value per logical input row; the Rducks mode controls whether R is called once per row or once per DuckDB chunk. Execution plans choose marshalling and concurrency without redefining SQL type, NULL, or result semantics.

name: rducks_is_type
description: Check whether an object is a structurally valid Rducks DuckDB type descriptor.
